summary: This small application puts the two bakery domain classes to work: it makes one plain Cookie and one DecoratedCookie, then prints the description each object returns about itself.

lines.text: Calling the constructor with new builds one actual cookie in memory from the Cookie blueprint, and the flavor you pass in is stored inside that object.
A DecoratedCookie is created exactly the same way, because a subclass is still a full-fledged class you can instantiate; "Birthday" here is the decoration theme rather than a flavor.
The describe() method returns a String rather than printing it, so the application decides where the text goes — here to the console.
This is the same method name as above, but DecoratedCookie overrides describe(), so each object runs its own version and the output differs.
